author: ImJeezus
body:
meh copy lft from ocn cuz im a lazy asshole

So, anyway, my name is Jeezus, I am at the age of 16, in a PST timezone, and mainly an offensive ground rusher or painlooper. I'm alright at any type of PvP except PotPvP. I usually follow directions and will try to get an objective completed. I can usually play any type of position in CTW except defense, I usually excel in offense however. In DTC/DTM, I am mainly an offender by far. I can straight-bridge alright(a bit quickly) and ninja bridge/staircase pretty well. I have 3 main ways of communication(Skype, Mumble TS3), but my mic is pretty shitty and makes me sound like a downie and overall very quiet; I also have quite a lot of background noise at times, which is a big reason why I do not talk much in any form of communication. I have experience in a total of 5 events, 3 tourneys(HoC,GoG, and Conquest) and 2 mini events (BiAB and SWW).

Other Downsides(Technology Wise)

Logitech Mouse

Comcast(Might get a different brand on internet soon)

A pretty bad computer

If interested add me on skype(tntturltes) or give me your skype
